body.name: Landing Zone
body.description: Personal tiles for an organisation account. Internal target names are resolved live, and tile target data grants no access to its target.

permissions.label: Create tile
permissions.description: Allows creating tiles owned by the current organisation account.

permissions.label: Read tile
permissions.description: Allows reading tiles owned by the current organisation account.

permissions.label: Update tile
permissions.description: Allows updating tiles owned by the current organisation account.

permissions.label: Delete tile
permissions.description: Allows deleting tiles owned by the current organisation account.

permissions.label: Remove tile
permissions.description: Allows the named removal of tiles owned by the current organisation account, with current standard delete authority also required.

permissions.label: Read applications
permissions.description: Allows reading applications reachable by the current person.
